steps.text:
The page at https://example.com has no main heading. I fetched it live, and there's no `<h1>` or any other heading tag in the HTML.

- **Page title:** "Example Domain". This is the `<title>` tag, which browsers show on the tab, not a heading on the page.
- **Page content:** An icon, then one short paragraph in six languages (English, Arabic, Chinese, French, Russian and Spanish). The English version says: "This domain is for use in documentation examples without needing permission. This is not a service; avoid relying on it for testing and monitoring purposes."
- **Link:** A "Learn more" link to https://iana.org/help/example-domains.

Two notes on how I got this:
- The Kagi extract tool failed because no Kagi API key is set up, so I used Firecrawl.
- My first Firecrawl results were a cached copy, so I fetched the page again live (scrape ID `01a1757f-e62a-76b4-8ab8-028d9a4b71a6`, HTTP 200). It also had no heading.
